title: Preparing Trainee Teachers for Changing Demands of Education
what_it_is: Preparing Trainee Teachers for Changing Demands of Education

sections.label: NIE teacher preparation curriculum
sections.summary: NIE works with MOE to deliver pre-service and in-service teacher development, balancing theory with practice, research and school partnerships.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: The National Institute of Education (NIE) works closely with the Ministry of Education (MOE) to deliver both pre-service preparation and in-service professional development to support teachers throughout their careers to become competent and caring teachers who are respected by their students and the public, and who can work well in teams with their peers and the community.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: The curriculum balances theory with practice, is backed by research and is supported by a robust partnership with MOE and schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: It prepares pre-service teachers to meet the changing demands of education by first, deepening professionalism through a focus on a deep understanding of their student learners, developing values and professional ethos, and ownership of learning.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Second, strengthening practice through practicum in schools that hone their craft and develop their inquiry and reflective skills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Third, broadening the repertoire of pedagogies that can promote innovation, inquiry- and technology-based learning.

sections.label: Unchanging teacher preparation priorities
sections.summary: Values inculcation and basic pedagogy will never change, with teachers needing skills for high needs students, external partners and lifelong technology use.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Two things will never change in our preparation of the teachers: one, that of values inculcation; two, the basic pedagogical approach of how to teach and teach well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: First, as Ms Denise Phua said, we will need more of our teachers to pick up the basic skills to help the high needs students and the special needs students.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Second, we will need our teachers to be able to work with partners beyond the school environment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Third, we will need our teachers to learn throughout their life to make use of the latest technologies available – how to use technology to scale up the size of the classroom so that we can spend more time to attend to the high needs students.
